title: Microsoft Purview DLP: block Microsoft 365 Copilot responses to prompts containing sensitive data
summary: Hold for two scope corrections: Microsoft documents prompt protection for prebuilt agents, and custom policy-tip links are not supported for Cowork. The roadmap facts, licensing, simulation default and documented commands are supported.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is Launched.
claims.quote: "status": "Launched"

claims.claim: The roadmap release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.claim: The roadmap target is March CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "March CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap preview date is November CY2025.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "November CY2025"

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap platform is Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.claim: The record names Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365).
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Purview", "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)"]

claims.claim: The roadmap describes a real-time control to safeguard sensitive prompts.
claims.quote: This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks

claims.claim: The roadmap includes pre-built agents in the Copilot response restriction.
claims.quote: preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot, including pre-built agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot,  from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data

claims.claim: The roadmap says the control prevents sensitive prompt data being used for Microsoft 365 or web grounding.
claims.quote: or using that sensitive data for grounding in Microsoft 365 or the web.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: A configured prompt-processing rule prevents Copilot responding when typed prompt text matches chosen SITs.
claims.quote: Detects when the text entered directly into a Copilot or Cowork prompt contains chosen sensitive information types. The experience doesn't respond to the prompt.

claims.claim: The blocked prompt is not used for internal or web searches.
claims.quote: The prompt isn't used for internal or web searches.

claims.claim: Prompt protection uses the Copilot location and Content contains > Sensitive information types condition.
claims.quote: create DLP policies that use the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location with the Content contains > Sensitive information types condition.

claims.claim: The table names Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content > Processing prompts, while the example says Restrict Copilot from processing content > Processing prompts.
claims.quote: Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content > Processing prompts; The actions in the rule are configured to Restrict Copilot from processing content > Processing prompts.

claims.claim: Only out-of-the-box and custom SITs are currently supported.
claims.quote: Only out-of-the-box and custom SITs are currently supported.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: DLP checks typed prompt text, not the contents of files uploaded directly into prompts.
claims.quote: DLP can't scan the contents of files that you upload directly into prompts, so evaluation of the uploaded file for sensitive data doesn't occur. DLP only checks the text you type into the prompt itself.

claims.claim: Prompt blocking is supported for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Cowork supports this feature, along with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

claims.claim: Cowork supports prompt blocking.
claims.quote: Cowork supports this feature

claims.claim: Copilot in Word supports prompt blocking.
claims.quote: Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

claims.claim: Copilot in Excel supports prompt blocking.
claims.quote: Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

claims.claim: Copilot in PowerPoint supports prompt blocking.
claims.quote: Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

claims.claim: Learn still marks prompt blocking as preview and rolling out to tenants with Copilot and Copilot Chat access.
claims.quote: This feature is in preview and is rolling out to all tenants with access to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. Check whether rollout has reached your tenant.

claims.claim: Microsoft supplies Default DLP policy - Protect sensitive M365 Copilot interactions to detect SITs in prompts.
claims.quote: Microsoft created a default DLP policy called Default DLP policy - Protect sensitive M365 Copilot interactions. The default policy detects sensitive information types (SIT) in user prompts.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Prompt blocking is admin-opt-in: the default policy simulates without blocking until an administrator enables enforcement.
claims.quote: The policy is in simulation mode by default, which means it doesn't block the prompt; If you want to block processing of the prompt, you must change the state of the policy to enforce mode.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The default policy logs matching events in simulation mode.
claims.quote: This means that the event will only be logged.

claims.claim: The default policy generates an Alert event for a match.
claims.quote: The policy doesn't generate any policy tips for end users, but it does generate an Alert event.

claims.claim: The default policy sends email to the administrator if configured.
claims.quote: generates an alert and sends an email to the admin (if configured).

claims.claim: The default policy's administrator email has low severity.
claims.quote: It also triggers a low severity email to the admin (added in the policy).

claims.claim: The default SIT list includes bank account numbers.
claims.quote: Australia Bank Account Number; Canada Bank Account Number; U.S. Bank Account Number

claims.claim: The default SIT list includes IP addresses.
claims.quote: IP Address; IP Address v4; IP Address v6

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Sensitivity labels protect files and emails through a different action and cannot share a rule with the SIT condition.
claims.quote: You can't use both content contains sensitive info types and content contains sensitivity labels conditions in the same rule. You can create a rule for each condition in the same policy, but not in the same rule.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends using roles with the fewest permissions.
claims.quote: Microsoft recommends that you use roles with the fewest permissions.

claims.claim: Copilot prompts run in the security context of the submitting user.
claims.quote: All Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts run in the security context of the user who initiates the prompt.

claims.claim: Copilot DLP policy scoping follows the user who submits the prompt.
claims.quote: DLP policy scoping for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork is based on the user who submits the prompt, not the owner of a file or email that the experience accesses.

claims.claim: The rule takes no other action on the user's data.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Copilot prompt blocking modifies deletes user data'. Read the Copilot DLP feature and default-policy pages and Copilot privacy search excerpts; none states this exhaustive no-other-action claim.
claims.fix: Replace the bullet with 'The prompt-processing action prevents a response and internal or web searches.' This is the documented outcome at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Blocked users receive a message that their request cannot be completed because it contains sensitive information the organisation blocked Copilot from using.
claims.quote: they receive a message indicating that the request can't be completed because it contains sensitive information that the organization has blocked Microsoft 365 Copilot or Cowork from using.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: During preview, Word, Excel and PowerPoint messaging may not clearly identify an organisational-policy block.
claims.quote: During preview, the user messaging in Word, Excel, PowerPoint might not clearly state that the interaction with Copilot in those products is blocked due to an organizational policy.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: DLP policy updates can take up to four hours to reach these Copilot experiences.
claims.quote: Updates to a DLP policy can take up to four hours to reflect in the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork experiences.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: DLP to safeguard prompts is included in every plan column shown in the service description's Copilot DLP table, including the named Business, Microsoft 365, Office 365 and Purview-suite plans.
claims.quote: *Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to safeguard prompts | Included* | Included* | Included* | Included* | Included*

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The service description says prompt DLP is available to all Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat users.
claims.quote: *Purview DLP for prompts is available to all users of Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat

claims.quote: Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to restrict Copilot from processing files and emails | Not included | Not included | Not included | Included | Included

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a separate price or meter specific to Processing prompts.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview DLP safeguard prompts pricing meter billing'. Read the service description's Copilot DLP table, feature page and purview-billing-models; no Processing prompts-specific price or meter is stated.

claims.claim: A separate roadmap item covers prompt protection for the US government clouds.
claims.quote: 561892: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts for government clouds; "clouds": ["GCC", "GCC High", "DoD"]

claims.claim: The Copilot DLP location is available only in the Custom policy template.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location is only available in the Custom policy template.

claims.claim: Selecting the Copilot DLP location disables every other location in that policy.
claims.quote: When you select the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location, all other locations for that policy are disabled.

claims.claim: Policy simulation mode is available for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.
claims.quote: Policy simulation mode is available for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.

claims.claim: Administrative unit scoping is in preview and rolling out for this location.
claims.quote: Administrative unit support for this location, including Cowork, is in preview and is rolling out. The option might not yet be available in your tenant.
claims.fix: Add the qualification 'Microsoft's education deployment guide instead says the policy location does not support Administrative Units.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/education/guide/1-reference/purview-data-security-posture-management-education, whose Known limitations section states that conflicting restriction.

claims.claim: DLP alerts are supported for this location.
claims.quote: DLP alerts and DLP notifications are supported.

claims.claim: DLP notifications are supported for this location.
claims.quote: DLP alerts and DLP notifications are supported.

claims.claim: The printed Purview path reaches the Copilot policy location and its Processing prompts rule action.
claims.quote: Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy. Select the Custom template, then Custom policy. On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on. Add a rule
claims.fix: Make the omitted rule target explicit: 'Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Custom > Custom policy > Locations > Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork > rule > Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content > Processing prompts'. The cited page says to add a rule before setting its action.

claims.claim: No documented automation value has been published for the Processing prompts action at November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview DLP Processing prompts RestrictAccess PowerShell Set-DlpComplianceRule'; 'DLP Copilot prompt restrict access PowerShell BlockPrompt'. Read New-/Set-DlpComplianceRule RestrictAccess sections and Copilot DLP page; no prompt-processing value is documented.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Purview > Data Loss prevention > Policies > policy > Edit > Policy mode > Turn the policy on immediately enables enforcement.
claims.quote: Go to Data Loss prevention > Policies. selecting the policy in the list of policies and selecting the edit button. Change the Policy mode to Turn the policy on immediately which enforces the block prompt processing action

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Set-DlpCompliancePolicy -Identity "<policy>" -Mode Enable enables a DLP policy's actions and notifications.
claims.quote: The Identity parameter specifies the DLP policy that you want to modify. The Mode parameter specifies the action and notification level of the DLP policy. Enable: The policy is enabled for actions and notifications.

claims.claim: TestWithNotifications and TestWithoutNotifications are Set-DlpCompliancePolicy simulation modes.
claims.quote: TestWithNotifications: Simulation mode where no actions are taken, but notifications are sent. TestWithoutNotifications: Simulation mode where no actions are taken, and no notifications are sent.

claims.claim: Editing the default policy requires DLP Compliance Management permissions.
claims.quote: To edit the default policy for better performance or to delete it, use an account with DLP Compliance Management permissions.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Purview > Settings > Roles and scopes > Role groups > Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions > role group > Edit > Edit members of the role group > Choose users adds role-group members.
claims.quote: Go to Settings > Roles and scopes. Select Role groups. On Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions, select a Microsoft Purview role group you want to add users to. Select Edit on the control bar. On Edit members of the role group, select Choose users or Choose groups.

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "<role-group>" -Member "<user-UPN>" adds the identified user to a role group.
claims.quote: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group. The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to. The Member parameter specifies who you want to add; User ID or user principal name (UPN)

claims.claim: Managing Purview role-group membership in the portal requires the Role management role.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal by using credentials for an admin account assigned the Role management role.

claims.claim: New-DlpComplianceRule lists RestrictAccess without a substantive parameter description.
claims.quote: ### -RestrictAccess; {{ Fill RestrictAccess Description }}

claims.claim: RestrictWebGrounding blocks web grounding rather than withholding the whole Copilot response.
claims.quote: The RestrictWebGrounding parameter specifies an action for the DLP rule that blocks web grounding. $true: Web grounding is blocked.

claims.claim: The cited Copilot DLP feature page does not mention pre-built agents.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview DLP prompts pre-built agents sensitive information types'. Read the complete dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about page; it names Copilot, Copilot Chat, Cowork and Office apps, but not pre-built agents.

claims.claim: Whether Processing prompts covers pre-built Copilot agents remains an open documentation question.
claims.quote: This phase creates the enforceable DLP policy that protects Microsoft Copilot and prebuilt agents from processing sensitive prompts or sensitive labeled content. Protection pattern A: Set the action to Prevent Copilot from processing content > Processing prompts.
claims.fix: Remove this open question. Replace the second sentence of Scope: Users with 'The roadmap names pre-built agents, and Microsoft's education deployment guide documents Processing prompts protection for Microsoft Copilot and prebuilt agents, although the Copilot DLP feature page does not name them.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/education/guide/1-reference/purview-data-security-posture-management-education.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends turning on Incident reports and adding the security team as email recipients.
claims.quote: Microsoft recommends that you at least edit the policy to turn on Incident reports and add your security team as recipients of the email notifications

claims.claim: Removing irrelevant SITs from the default policy can reduce false positives.
claims.quote: Remove sensitive information types that aren't relevant to your organization to reduce false positives and improve performance.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout, compliance URL
claims.claim: A rule's policy-tip compliance URL makes the block message link to the organisation's guidance without a Cowork exception.
claims.quote: When the rule blocks an interaction, the Learn about access restrictions link opens the page that you specified. Customizing the link in Copilot policy tips isn't yet supported for Cowork.
claims.fix: Replace the bullet with 'For Copilot, set a compliance URL in the rule's policy tips so the block message links to your own guidance page; customising this link is not yet supported for Cowork.' The exception is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about#customize-the-link-in-copilot-policy-tips.

claims.claim: The checklist tells administrators to enable Incident reports, but no controls-table row covers that setting.
claims.quote: Turn on Incident reports for the Copilot policy; controls rows cover prompt processing, policy mode and role-group membership, not Incident reports.
claims.fix: Remove the Incident reports instruction from the checklist. It has no corresponding controls row; do not add a row as part of this correction.

claims.claim: The checklist tells administrators to set the policy-tip compliance URL, but no controls-table row covers that setting.
claims.quote: Set a compliance URL in the rule's policy tips; controls rows cover prompt processing, policy mode and role-group membership, not the compliance URL.
claims.fix: Remove the compliance-URL instruction from the checklist instead of adding a new controls row. Removing it also resolves its missing Cowork qualification.
